verdict.rationale: Kong Gateway is open-source (GitHub repo) and explicitly supports self-hosted deployment models including Docker, DB-less, and Hybrid deployments 'without any vendor lock-in', with admin API/decK for configuration and a quickstart script for local setup. This covers the core gateway/AI Gateway functionality, not just the SaaS Konnect offering. Missing for 10: no independent third-party confirmation of large-scale self-hosted production use, and some newer AI/MCP capabilities (Catalog, Konnect MCP Server) appear tied to the Konnect SaaS platform rather than self-hosted core.
